dish: tacos al pastor shaved off the trompo (vertical spit)
w: Grew from a west-side taco truck into Columbus's most celebrated taqueria — al pastor carved off the trompo, voted best tacos in the Midwest and a Diners, Drive-Ins & Dives stop. Open and busy in 2026 (kitchen to midnight/1am).

dish: NY-style pizza by the slice + signature garlic sauce
w: Columbus's original late-night slice since 2009 (grew out of a pedicab side hustle). Went viral after a Netflix 'Love Is Blind' cameo triggered a reported ~5,000% spike in garlic-sauce sales; irreverent Short North institution.

The neon-sign OSU campus landmark on High Street since 1969 — 24/7/365, 29 hand-cut donut varieties plus a hand-cut gyro-and-Greek line added in 2002. A generational Ohio State tradition and perennial 'best donuts in central Ohio'.

dish: smash-grilled Ohio-beef burger with special sauce
w: Chefs Matt Heaggans & Catie Randazzo's cult smash burger — Ohio beef, American cheese, pickles and special sauce. A James Beard Blended Burger Project entrant that graduated from pop-up to a beloved Clintonville brick-and-mortar next to Combustion Brewery.
